points.quote: `defineBlockSchema({flavour, props, metadata, toModel})` ... `flavour` is the namespaced id, such as `'affine:paragraph'`. ... `metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`)
`metadata` holds `version`, `role` (such as `'content'`) and the allowed `parent` flavours.
The model is a class extending `BlockModel<Props>`, for example `ParagraphBlockModel`.

The component extends `BlockComponent<Model>` from `@blocksuite/std`. ... Children go through `this.std.host.renderChildren(model)` ... `BlockViewExtension('affine:paragraph', literal\`affine-paragraph\`)`, which maps the flavour to the tag name

`StoreExtensionProvider`, in `store.ts`. `setup(context)` calls `context.register(ParagraphBlockSchemaExtension)`, plus adapter extensions ... `ViewExtensionProvider`, in `view.ts`. ... `StoreExtensionManager` and `ViewExtensionManager` ... collect the providers.
Its `effect()` calls `effects()` to define the custom elements.
